method.independence: Static gold answers were recomputed by solvers written in the audit scratch dir from the PROMPT TEXT only (regex parsing of examples/facts/definitions). The repo's generator code was read for orientation but not imported for static gold. The repo's environment classes were imported only to simulate interactive episodes (allowed); the repo's CANON functions were imported only to probe which surface forms the scorer accepts.
method.list_induction: Named-family solver with a free parameter search (e.g. add_k k in -50..50, keep_gt k in -1..100, drop/take/rotate k in 1..9) -> unique answer check; ambiguity: own 250+-rule library (elementwise affine/mod/floordiv, reorders, rotations both directions, threshold filters both directions, index filters, aggregates incl. count>k/range/first/last, structural appends/prepends/cumsum/pairwise) applied to every item.
method.string_induction: Named-family parameter search; own 120+-rule library (caesar 1..25, vowel->any letter, consonant->letter, rotations both ways, first/last k, drop first/last k, wraps, mirrors, dedupe); minimal-evidence rules (replace/remove only the letters actually seen transformed).
method.sequence_induction: Named-family check + own model set: polynomial by finite differences (>=2 confirming terms), geometric, affine order-1 recurrence r in -5..5, order-2 linear recurrences with constant, alternating and period-3 differences, interleaved arithmetic; disagreement => ambiguity; constant/arithmetic sequences under a non-arithmetic family flagged degenerate.
method.defined_ops: Own semantics for each English definition; nested/conditional/conditional_chain expressions parsed from the prompt and evaluated; worked examples re-checked against the definitions.
method.scan_language: Own interpreter of the stated definitions (verbs, twice/thrice modifiers binding to the previous command, left-to-right connectives); demos re-checked.
method.counterfactual_arith: Own semantics for each redefined operator from its English text; recursive-descent parser with parentheses; flags unparenthesized chains (none found).
method.ordering: Brute force over all permutations of the people NAMED in the prompt; uniqueness of the ASKED position; ages solved by propagation; compared named-people count to the difficulty's expected count.
method.entity_tracking: Replay of the stated operations; 'which box' / 'which items' answered from the final state.
method.knights_knaves: Brute force over 2^n worlds with own statement semantics ('us' = everyone in the puzzle); uniqueness required.
method.graph_paths: BFS over the stated one-way roads; town universe = towns named in the prompt.
method.letter_analogy: Named rule check + own 30-rule library (succ/pred first/last/all, shifts by 2/3, extend run vs append successor, three readings of swap-halves for odd length, rotations, wraps, mirror, repeat); query==demo-input leak check.
method.grid_transform: Named-family check (recolor/border colour as free parameters) + own 400+-rule library (all symmetries, gravity 4 ways, cyclic and zero-fill shifts 4 ways, mirrors 3 ways, border fill/overwrite any colour, count fills in 4 orders, all single recolors, observed colour map); leak checks (test input == demo input, gold == demo output).
method.interactive: probe_function: verify stored answer = f(target); adaptive greedy query selection (minimize worst-case number of distinct f(target) among survivors) over (a) the env's own library of 6 families with exact parameter ranges (5,685 hypotheses) and (b) a broader 15.6k-hypothesis class of the same shapes with extra coefficients and wider ranges; sequential-scan baseline. hidden_buttons: own BFS optimum vs stored optimal_presses; 'press each button once (all 6 orders), then plan optimally' and 'explore two buttons then plan' policies; oracle plan replayed through the env. code_breaker: worst case over ALL codes of each (family, difficulty) config with Knuth-style greedy minimax, plus a constructive depth-bounded strategy search for the one config over budget; prompt/spec consistency; terminal replay.
method.duplicates: exact prompt, content_sha256, semantic signature (query+answer per family; expression with definitions substituted; env spec), and renaming-invariant signature (people/towns/items/nonsense words replaced by order-of-appearance placeholders, answer mapped through the same renaming); union of equivalences gives the independent-item estimate. Cross-checked against calibration_v1/v2.
method.format: For every gold, a set of plausible \boxed{} surface forms per answer type was passed through the scorer's own canonicalizer (score_battery uses tasks.common.CANON) to find renderings that a correct model answer could take but would be scored wrong; interactive action regexes probed with common markdown variants.
method.teacher: teacher_dev score rows (tasks_sha256 matches this file) and raw records from artifacts/stages/stage-0/calibration_volume/battery_20261018_092345/teacher_dev; every static teacher failure was compared with the audit's own answer and inspected by hand.
